name: mission-control-agency-swarm-v5
description: Mission Control: Agency Swarm v5 (Haiku-Sonnet 3.5 Edition) — orchestration dashboard for 148 specialized agents, routed through OmniRoute.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,white "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n SRV,CLI,EL -c cyan,white,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "electron ."
